dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Did you know that the Sumpter Beasts in the port were all raised by my dad?

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Of course! What about your dad? Does he do anything amazing?

dialogues.speaker: Zai
dialogues.text: My dad... I don't think he's good at anything. He just hangs around at home all day, playing cards and having sunbaths.

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Does that mean your family doesn't even have one Sumpter Beast...?

dialogues.speaker: Zai
dialogues.text: Yeah, we don't. There are people with Sumpter Beasts who often come looking for my dad, but they would soon take the Sumpter Beasts away and leave nothing for us...

dialogues.speaker: Zai
dialogues.text: So I've always been curious. Sumpter Beasts look like huge loaves of bread... Do they taste as good as buttered bread, too?

dialogues.speaker: Zai
dialogues.text: My family has lots of big ships at sea, so we eat fish every day. All kinds of fish. And I'm getting sick of it!

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Poor you... I haven't eaten Sumpter Beasts either, but I can ask my father if he can spare one for you.
